PUBLICATIONS
April 1, 1995
Dear Sirs,
I take great pleasure in sending you a copy of our most recent publication, "JAPAN TRADE
DIRECTORY 1995–96” (JTD). As a comprehensive and invaluable trade reference guide, this
directory provides information on potential Japanese trading partners to overseas corporations
interested in doing business in Japan.
The Japan External Trade Organization (JETRO), a firm believer in the principle of free trade,
feels strongly that balanced international trade is essential for the world economy, and JTD has
been complied with this in mind. The rise in domestic demand in Japan for imported goods is
reflected in the increased number of companies listed who are looking for import
opportunities.
The information contained in the directory covers approximately 2,800 Japanese companies
with about 21,000 products and services, and is much more detailed than conventional
directories.
In addition, for more convenient and easier access to relevant information, the new edition has
a considerably supplemented index structure.
I sincerely hope that you will find this dir ctory useful and practical, and that it will make
positive contribution to the development of bilateral trade between your country and Japan.
Sincerely yours,
J. Date
Yoshinori Date
